plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official EMU catalog program page 'Program: Mechanical Engineering [BS]' (Major Requirements 85-87 hours: 32-hour Math and Science Requirements + 44-46-hour Technical Requirements) for all course codes, titles and credits; (2) the official EMU General Education worksheet (FA22) for gen-ed structure. catalog.emich.edu presents an AWS WAF challenge to automated fetching, so catalog content was verified through the search index of the official catalog pages; every code, title and credit below comes from those official sources. The 85-87-hour major total implies 9 hours of technical electives beyond the documented 76 hours; these are modeled as three 3-credit technical-elective choice slots (student selects approved ME technical electives with an advisor). ME options used throughout (ME 312, ME 316, ME 317 - not the PHY alternatives). ME 492W satisfies the Writing Intensive [GEWI] requirement in the major; this major does not require a minor. PREREQUISITES ARE NOT ENCODED: catalog course pages are WAF-blocked and prereqs are never invented per project rules - courses are sequenced in standard engineering order (calculus, physics, statics/dynamics, thermo/fluids/design, capstone); confirm official prerequisites with the catalog and an advisor before registering. 85 major + 30 gen-ed = 115 specified credits; free-elective choice slots (5 cr) reach the 120-credit minimum.
